description: Southpark at Cinco Ranch is a premier community shopping center strategically located at the intersection of two main Houston area roads in Katy, Texas, serving the nation's top-selling master-planned community. This 264,667 square foot open-air center is anchored by leading retailers including Kroger, Academy Sports, and Spec's Liquor and Finer Foods, providing essential shopping and services to one of Houston's most affluent suburban markets. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, the property exemplifies the company's Fresh Look® philosophy of creating thriving neighborhood centers that serve as community gathering places. With approximately 2.5 million annual visits, the center has established itself as the go-to destination for residents of Cinco Ranch and surrounding Katy communities. The property's strong performance is supported by exceptional demographics, including a 3-mile household income of $183,539 and average home values exceeding $526,000, making it an attractive location for quality retailers seeking to serve discerning suburban shoppers.
